description: This file defines data structures, function declarations, and inline functions related to bitmap handling and compression using the EWAH (Efficient Word-Aligned Hybrid) technique. It includes functionality for creating, freeing, serializing, and manipulating compressed bitmaps, as well as operations like setting bits, iterating, and bitwise operations.

classes.name: ewah_bitmap
classes.description: Represents a compressed bitmap using the EWAH compression scheme, containing buffers, size details, and a run-length word pointer.

classes.name: ewah_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing an uncompressed representation of the ewah_bitmap.

classes.name: ewah_or_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for performing OR operations across multiple ewah_bitmaps.

classes.name: bitmap
classes.description: Uncompressed bitmap data structure suitable for conversion to and from compressed ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: uint32_t ewah_bit_popcount64(uint64_t x)
methods.description: Efficiently counts the number of set bits in a 64-bit unsigned integer without using built-in functions.

methods.name: int ewah_bit_ctz64(uint64_t x)
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in a 64-bit unsigned integer, using built-in compiler support if available, otherwise a manual implementation.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to run through the uncompressed form of an ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next uncompressed word of the bitmap in iteration.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to perform OR operation across multiple ewah_bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_next
methods.description: Fetches the next combined word result of the OR across multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_xor
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR operation between two ewah_bitmaps, storing the result in a third.

methods.name: ewah_add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds a number of empty (all zero or all one) words to an ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
methods.description: Adds raw uncompressed words to the ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add
methods.description: Adds a single word to the ewah_bitmap, updating its compressed structure.

methods.name: bitmap_new
methods.description: Creates a new uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_word_alloc
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with a specified amount of pre-allocated words.

methods.name: bitmap_dup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_unset
methods.description: Unsets (clears) a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_equals
methods.description: Checks if two bitmaps are equal.

methods.name: bitmap_equals_ewah
methods.description: Checks if an uncompressed bitmap is equal to a compressed ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Determines if the set bits in one bitmap are a subset of another.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Determines if one ewah_bitmap is a subset of an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_to_ewah
methods.description: Converts an uncompressed bitmap into a compressed ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_to_bitmap
methods.description: Decompresses an ewah_bitmap into an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_and_not
methods.description: Performs a bitwise AND of one bitmap with the negation of another.

methods.name: bitmap_or_ewah
methods.description: Performs a bitwise OR of an uncompressed bitmap with a compressed ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_or
methods.description: Performs a bitwise OR of two uncompressed bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a compressed ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_empty
methods.description: Checks whether a bitmap has no bits set.
